personality.description: This person is imaginative and intellectually curious, often exploring unusual ideas, trying new approaches, and changing plans when something more interesting appears. In daily habits, they tend to be flexible and spontaneous, but also somewhat disorganized, with a tendency to postpone tasks or overlook details when routines feel restrictive. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually respond with strong empathy and a desire to protect harmony, even if that means compromising their own preferences; afterward, they may worry a great deal about whether they made the right choice. In group discussions, they speak cautiously and thoughtfully, preferring small, calm exchanges, listening closely, and offering supportive, considerate remarks rather than dominating the conversation.
